verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then

  exit 1
fi

findings.message: tasks.md 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 edit .feature files (locations_view_contract_e2e.feature, locations_ui_e2e.feature, locations_search_shortcut_e2e.feature) but verify with `npx playwright test -c playwright.bdd.config.ts …` without first running `npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts` (only 8.1 does; the package's own `test:bdd` script is `bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.bdd.config.ts`). Playwright runs the generated specs, so 8.2's `--grep "See the Here entry without home"` finds no test, and 8.3/8.4 run the stale versions of the scenarios they changed, so these tasks are not independently verifiable as written. Prefix each verification with the bddgen step.

findings.message: docs/architecture/domain-model.md:89 names `getRows(state)` as the selector returning 'display rows: the derived Here entry first when no location matches the device zone, then `locations`', and line 90 lists an 'is-derived' flag on the row snapshot. The change instead adds a separate `getHereEntry` selector, keeps the Here entry out of the rows and rejects a combined row (design D1/D2/D5). No task or handoff patch updates domain-model.md (H2 only patches views.md), so docs and code name two different owners for the Here entry.

Proposal 'What Changes' says '**Here mark**, **Offset difference**, **Location menu**: unchanged', but on main docs/glossary has no 'Location menu' entry at all, and 'Offset difference' in docs/glossary/time.md:21 is still '*(planned)*' with no Code owner. Those terms come only from the unapplied archived patch set-home-location-and-show-differences/handoff/H1-glossary-home-location.patch, which touches the same docs/glossary/locations.md and views.md as this change's H1. Task 9.1/H1 does not state that dependency or the apply order (no `--3way` note, unlike H2), so the claim about the glossary is false on main.

UX3 ('Replacing the derived city with the exemplar city does not change the Here entry's height or move the cards below it') is checked only by task 6.2's jsdom class check 'the city slot is single-line (`truncate`)', and the 'Here entry layout' spec requirement has no scenario for it. bdd-unit.md puts 'Responsive layout' in E2E, not unit tests; add a playwright-bdd scenario that measures the Here entry's height and the next card's position before and after the exemplar city loads.

NFR-A2 and the spec requirement 'Accessible Here entry' say its day track 'MUST be one Tab stop', but no E2E scenario or task checks Tab order: 'Name and list size' (task 8.1) checks only the accessible name, the list size and the slider name. bdd-unit.md puts 'Keyboard accessibility' in E2E.
